changes: First release of Jan Kolkmeier's Deja Vu: three new audio-track LFO waves, DJV, DJQ and DJC, that play a loop of remembered random values, for card builds and, for beta testers, over USB.
SPD sets how often a step of the loop replays its value or rolls a new one, from 0 (always new) to 127 (locked). MULT sets the loop length and TRIG what moves through it.
DJV steps through the values, DJQ plays root, fifth and octaves on PTCH, DJC glides from value to value. Switching between them keeps the loop.
Documentation only: the author's name, and a removal with the waves in use (USB trial on one MKII: a stock wave plays, no hang).
Known issue: not yet tested on a unit with the HOLD, TRIG, ONE or HALF modes, scenes on SPD, or on an MKI. A project using the waves opened without the module plays SAW.
